purpose: Unmodified metric-compatible substitute so documents asking for Calibri / Calibri Light render on screen with the same widths when the real font is not installed (macOS). Same substitute the document engine uses (platform/os_services/macos.py).

carlito.name: Carlito
carlito.copyright: Copyright 2013 The Carlito Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/carlito), with Reserved Font Name "Carlito"
carlito.vietnamese: all precomposed Vietnamese letters; no combining tone marks (decomposed text falls back per character)

not_bundled.Caladea (Cambria): Caladea 1.x lacks 48 Vietnamese letters (horn vowels, hook above, dot below), so a Vietnamese run would mix two typefaces; Cambria falls back to the platform serif instead.
not_bundled.Liberation Sans/Serif/Mono (Arial, Times: Windows and macOS ship these three fonts; the web stacks name the Liberation/Arimo/Tinos/Cousine families as local fallbacks only.
